site.name: WANDOAK
site.metaTitle: WANDOAK — Women's Performance Sportswear, Made in Our Own Factory
site.metaDescription: WANDOAK is a women's sportswear brand backed by a 35,000 m² factory in Ningbo, China. 600,000 pcs/month, cut-and-sewn and seamless, GRS · BSCI · OEKO-TEX® certified. ODM production, brand partnership and team custom orders welcome.

hero.h1:
A brand that owns its factory.
A factory that thinks like a brand.
hero.sub1: WANDOAK — by Ningbo K&A Technology Co., Ltd.
hero.sub2: From yarn to finished garment, from body data to industry standards — all of it happens under our own roof.

who.h2: We didn't start from a sketch. We started from 20,000 bodies.
who.body:
WANDOAK was founded in 2012 as a sportswear brand built specifically around the healthy, active lives of urban women.

The brand didn't begin with a design drawing. At the 2012 London Olympics, a female boxer from Ningbo had to stop mid-match when her bra strap came loose. That moment convinced our founder to build a sports bra that genuinely fits — and genuinely holds — the bodies of Chinese women.

What followed was a study of more than 20,000 Chinese women's body shapes, 3D-scanned, analysed and distilled into a single sports bra engineered for how our customers are actually built.

design.h2: New Naturalism — design that begins with observation
design.body: We believe physical and mental wellbeing already belong to the natural world. So our design process starts there: observe nature, take it apart, put it back together as a product.
design.item1: Light dispersion — the purest spectrum sunlight breaks into
design.item2: The golden ratio of the nautilus shell
design.item3: The Fibonacci sequence in a sunflower head
design.item4: Crown shyness, raw minerals, a night sky
design.close: These are not prints we put on garments. They are where our colour, proportion and structure come from — built on sustainability, driven by technical innovation, in service of movement, life and nature coexisting.

design.heroH1: How we think before we cut
design.heroSub: Our design case rests on three things: a philosophy, a dataset, and a seat at the table where the standards get written.
design.s1Body:
New Naturalism isn't a visual style. It's a working method: observe nature, deconstruct it, rebuild it as product.

As yoga and training moved from indoors to outdoors, sportswear colour followed — toward health, toward the outdoors. Natural tones became the default for everyday training and off-duty wear, and that is exactly where our palette comes from: the purest spectral colours sunlight breaks into, and the hues of raw minerals.

For structure and proportion, we borrow nature's mathematics — the golden ratio of the nautilus, the Fibonacci sequence in a sunflower head, the breathing space that crown shyness leaves between trees.
design.s2Body:
East Asian women have their own proportions. Grading down a Western block will not produce a sports bra that genuinely fits.

We surveyed and studied more than 20,000 Chinese women's body shapes, then 3D-scanned, analysed and distilled the data — to rebuild a single sports bra made to fit our customers properly.

Advanced functional fabrics from home and abroad, combined with 3D cutting technique and tailored to East Asian proportions: that is the starting point of every WANDOAK product.
design.s3Body:
Together with the Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology (Chinese Academy of Sciences), the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Xi'an Polytechnic University, we drafted the impact-resistance standard for sports bras.

We were among the first companies in China to develop shock-absorbing sports bras, and we are currently initiating the drafting of a group standard for sports underwear.

The brand holds 10 invention patents for fabric, alongside a portfolio of design patents.

products.heroH1: Built for how she actually moves
products.heroLead: Technical performance and everyday wearability, in one wardrobe — for the many situations an urban woman dresses for. Yoga, running, light outdoor, city cycling: there is something here for each of them.
products.compressionBody: Alongside our core sports underwear line, compression leggings are our second product line — lifting, shaping and holding, and consistently one of our best-received ranges.

line.lead: Five representative pieces from the current range. Every one is developed and made on our own floor.
line.blackDesc: Five-way support in matte black, cut with a high-rise waistband that stays put through a full session.
line.sageDesc: A matched set in sage. Built for yoga and balance work, where a garment has to move and then hold still.
line.teeDesc: Technical fabric in a cut that reads as ordinary clothing — the piece that goes from the studio to the street.
line.cropDesc: A cropped top over a high waistband, so the midsection stays covered through overhead movement.
line.shortDesc: Higher-impact support with a lightweight short, for running and cardio.

products.handfeelBody:
Every piece in the range starts from the fabric, not the sketch. Our own sourcing and development teams select for hand, recovery and drape before a pattern is cut.

It is why two garments that look alike on a rail can wear completely differently on the body.

W2002543.name: Women's Sports Vest
W2002543.desc: An all-day bra cut in one piece with no seam lines through the body. A three-layer back panel and a full-width bonded hem carry the support; the removable pads are thinner at the top and thicker at the base, so the shape holds.
W2002543.fabric: Shell 84% polyester / 16% elastane · Lining 48.9% nylon / 51.1% elastane

W2102745.name: Women's Front-Zip Perforated Vest
W2102745.desc: A front-zip vest with an auto-locking slider and an inner hook, so it opens without pulling over the head. Laser perforation sits where sweat collects across the chest and back; the racer back leaves the shoulder blades free.
W2102745.fabric: Face 76% nylon / 24% elastane · Lining 86% polyester / 14% elastane · Cup lining 100% polyester · Mesh 86% polyester / 14% elastane
W2102745.colours: Obsidian black · Ocean blue · Avocado green · Cloud beige · Taro purple

W2102781.name: Women's Recycled-Fabric Vest
W2102781.desc: A longline bra in recycled polyester-elastane, cut with a V neck front and back. A 3cm bonded inner band gives medium support, and the pads come out for washing.
W2102781.fabric: Shell 84% polyester / 16% elastane · Lining 87% nylon / 13% elastane

W2302511.name: Women's Outerwear-Ready Vest
W2302511.desc: High support, and cut to be worn on its own. A double-layer back spreads the load, the armhole curves inward so the arm does not catch, and the back carries a reflective print for night running.
W2302511.fabric: Face 65% nylon / 35% elastane · Mesh 86% polyester / 14% elastane
W2302511.colours: Pearl white · Bright lemon · Lavender · Deep teal

W2302719.name: Women's Half-Zip Vest
W2302719.desc: A contrast half-zip with a full mesh lining that clears sweat fast. Reflective taping front and back, and a back logo that shifts colour under UV.
W2302719.fabric: Face 78% polyester / 22% elastane · Mesh 87% polyester / 13% elastane · Cup lining 100% polyester
W2302719.colours: Pale lilac · Quiet blue · Cloud beige · Obsidian black

W2302736.name: Women's Front-Zip Moulded-Cup Vest
W2302736.desc: High support in a light build, using the patented rabbit-ear moulded cup — ultra-thin, no show-through, and adjustable in position for different shapes. YKK auto-locking zip; princess seams through the front panel lift without compressing.
W2302736.fabric: Face 1 82% nylon / 18% elastane · Face 2 78% polyester / 22% elastane · Mesh 87% polyester / 13% elastane · Lining 100% polyester
W2302736.colours: Obsidian black · Peach pink · Quiet blue · Milk brown

W2302740.name: Women's Moulded-Cup Vest
W2302740.desc: The lightest build in the range, on the same patented rabbit-ear cup. Mesh panelling across the chest, a small pocket at the centre front for a key, and a four-row three-hook adjuster at the back.
W2302740.fabric: Face 76% nylon / 24% elastane · Mesh 87% polyester / 13% elastane · Lining 100% polyester
W2302740.colours: Obsidian black · Pearl white · Duck-egg green

W2306505.name: Women's Fitted Running Tee
W2306505.desc: A quick-dry knit whose fine cross-rib mesh structure moves sweat out fast. Panel lines shape the waist, the curved hem runs shorter at the front, and neck, cuff and hem are bonded rather than stitched.
W2306505.colours: China red · Pearl white · Dawn grey · Magenta · Sunflower gold · Emerald

W2107742.name: Women's Sports Legging
W2107742.desc: A high-gauge brushed nylon-elastane double knit, finished to a cotton-like hand. High through the waist, gusseted at the crotch for range, with an external drawcord and two side pockets.
W2107742.colours: Ocean blue · Avocado green · Obsidian black · Taro purple

W2304567.name: Men's Fitted Running Tee
W2304567.desc: Built for training and race pace in the same quick-dry knit as the women’s tee. Ergonomic hem, shorter at the front, with side splits; neck, cuff and hem are bonded to cut distraction.
W2304567.colours: China red · Pearl white · Dawn grey · Magenta · Sunflower gold · Emerald

W2304570.name: Men's Fitted Running Vest
W2304570.desc: The tee’s companion tank in the same knit, to wear alone or layered. A racer back frees the shoulder blades and every seam is bonded.
W2304570.colours: China red · Pearl white · Sunflower gold · Magenta · Emerald

W2307555.name: Men's Split-Hem Marathon Short
W2307555.desc: A race short: a supportive inner brief under a light woven outer, cut short and clean for speed. Five continuous stretch mesh pockets run right around the waistband and hold up to eight gels, a phone and a soft flask.
W2307555.fabric: Face 1 91% polyester / 9% elastane · Face 2 80% nylon / 20% elastane · Lining 60% nylon / 40% elastane
W2307555.colours: Rape green · Mulberry purple · Magenta · China red · Obsidian black

W2307571.name: Men's Compression Short
W2307571.desc: A five-inch compression short, 3D cut to follow the leg and hold the muscle through distance. A continuous waistband pocket with three openings takes a phone, four gels, tissues and keys; the gusset is built in a soft piqué.
W2307571.fabric: Face 78% polyester / 22% elastane · Mesh 87% polyester / 13% elastane
W2307571.colours: Nova blue · Wrought-iron grey · Sea teal

W2307573.name: Men's Compression Running Short
W2307573.desc: Multi-panel 3D cut following the line of the muscle. A jacquard open-work waistband lets air through, the back pocket is mesh, and the inner brief is bonded rather than stitched.
W2307573.fabric: Face 1 80% nylon / 20% elastane · Face 2 85% polyester / 15% elastane · Mesh 87% polyester / 13% elastane · Lining 60% nylon / 40% elastane
W2307573.colours: China red · Mulberry purple · Obsidian black

W2307578.name: Men's Running Short
W2307578.desc: A warp-knitted rib structure lets air through and dries faster, in a nylon-elastane with a cotton handle. Hidden back pocket, gusseted crotch, and a bonded seamless inner brief.
W2307578.fabric: Face 87% nylon / 13% elastane · Lining 60% nylon / 40% elastane
W2307578.colours: Washed blue · Sage · China red · Obsidian black

factory.capabilityH2: What we can build for you
factory.cutSewnDesc: Traditional and versatile garments constructed by cutting fabric pieces and sewing them together. This method allows for complex designs, a wide range of fabrics, and structured fits.
factory.cutSewnCovers: Sports bras · Leggings · Shorts & skirts · T-shirts · Jackets
factory.seamlessDesc: Innovative garments knitted from a single piece of fabric, eliminating side seams for a smooth, comfortable fit and reduced chafing.
factory.seamlessCovers: Bra & panty sets · Tops · Bra & legging sets · Dresses & bodysuits
factory.capabilityNote: Our range extends from sports bras and leggings through to swimwear and beachwear.

factory.rdBody2: Our professional service team is fluent in English and dedicated to seamless communication and responsive support.

factory.opsQualityDesc: Precision control ensures every stitch meets strict international standards.
